snippet: if (need > cellsList.length) return { ok: false, error: 'payload exceeds card capacity' };
reason: Equivalent: need = 48 + frameBytes*24 (HEADER_BITS*reps + payloadBits*reps). cellsList.length is 1342; 1342-48=1294 is not divisible by 24, so need is never exactly 1342. need is 1320 (fits) or 1344 (rejects) — it steps over 1342 — so > and >= decide identically on every reachable input.
